claimsToVerify: Capabilities · 'Upload video and large files (Pro & up) and embed them anywhere.' — plan-gate claim; confirm video/large-file upload really starts at Pro and that video embeds work anywhere.

Capabilities · 'Images serve from a global CDN, resized and optimized automatically.' and How it works step 03 'Every image is served responsive over a global CDN — the right size, the right format, fast everywhere.' — confirm automatic resize AND format conversion, not just CDN passthrough.
Capabilities · 'mark sensitive files private, served only through short-lived signed URLs' — confirm private assets are actually delivered via short-lived signed URLs.
Deep-dive mockup (121:1999) shows a delivery status line 'CDN · variants 320 / 640 / 1280' — verify those exact variant widths before shipping the mockup.

Hero · 'shared across every site and product' and Deep-dive · 'reuse the same asset across every site — no re-uploading' — cross-site reuse is a scoping claim; confirm it matches the visibleTo sharing model.
Early access stats (shared across all three pages): '9 products built in' and '0 plugins to wire up' — factual counts, confirm the current product count.

Explore card · Analytics 'Privacy-first traffic, top pages, and store revenue.' — safe as written (no visitors/conversions metric and no cross-site rollup), but confirm 'store revenue' appears in Analytics.
